title: Forcefield
answer: Forcefield is a innate aura action with defence intent. Aspects: FORCE, PROTECTION. Baseline potency 7, range 8.000, duration 200, energy 18, cooldown 200, residue 100, priority 10, and 2 generic presentation beats. Its standard signature uses the protection motif, innate_protection sound, and colours #58C7FF / #B9E7FF.
